Title: Public Preview: Combined Password Reset & MFA Registration

Body.Content:
Users can register security info for multi-factor authentication (MFA) and password reset in a single converged experience. Now when a user registers security info such as their phone number for receiving verification codes, that number can also be used for resetting a password. Likewise, users can change or delete their security info from a single page, making it easier to keep information up-to-date.

Learn more.
